description: This file defines the class SendThingMessageResponse, which represents a response message from a Thing in the context of Eclipse Ditto's signal command framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and encapsulates response details such as headers, message payload, and status code.

classes.name: SendThingMessageResponse
classes.description: Represents a response message from a Thing, including methods for creation from parameters or JSON. It extends AbstractMessageCommandResponse and is annotated for JSON parsing.

methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.description: Factory method to create an instance using a ThingId, message, status code, and headers.

methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object, given headers.
